title: Breathe
description: Take a moment to focus on your breath and relax.

title: Open a Window
description: Open a window that hasn't been opened in a while. Listen to what comes in.

title: Clear One Surface
description: Pick the flattest, most buried thing you own and empty it. One surface; not the room.

title: Fix the Thing That Rattles
description: Something here squeaks, sticks, or wobbles. Tighten it, oil it, or shim it with a folded receipt.

title: Sit Outside Your Own Front Door
description: A step, a wall, a chair; anything outside that holds you. Ten minutes, facing away from the house.
